subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land as the narrow fresh-session mitigation for accepted-disconnects, or wait for the reattach-first behavior proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The patch fixes same-session transcript duplication, but it intentionally preserves a product-sensitive two-run fallback boundary that can duplicate model/tool side effects and channel delivery.

options.title: Land Narrow Fix After Refresh
options.body: Rebase, document the new metadata value, rerun exact-head checks, and land this as the focused same-session collision fix while leaving reattach-first as follow-up.

options.title: Fold In Reattach-First
options.body: Ask the contributor to extend this branch into the broader reattach-first design so accepted disconnects prefer the authoritative gateway result before local fallback.

options.title: Pause For Direction
options.body: Keep the PR open but defer merge until maintainers decide whether duplicated model/tool side effects are acceptable for accepted disconnects.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Fix After Refresh
recommendation.body: Rebase, document the new metadata value, rerun exact-head checks, and land this as the focused same-session collision fix while leaving reattach-first as follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the agent CLI gateway dispatch and docs surface touched by the narrow fix.
